answer_1.quote: Our approach introduces a novel framework leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) to automatically generate insights.

answer_3.quote: To scale the evaluation of different insight generation models over a range of domains, we propose a new LLM-based evaluation model

answer_4.quote: For the human evaluation, we tasked a domain expert with performing 100 comparisons between insights generated by different methods on the private dataset.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators compared insights for insightfulness based on impact/actionability, interest/relevance, and clarity/precision/coherence; correctness was evaluated by verifying truth values of claims.
